name: org.machanism.machai:bindex-core
description: Bindex Core is a Java 17 library for creating, validating, registering, retrieving, and semantically recommending Bindex metadata for reusable software artifacts. A Bindex descriptor records Maven coordinates, licensing, authors, API features, examples, dependencies, and a rich classification. The library combines GenAI-generated classifications and embeddings with MongoDB vector search to recommend libraries from natural-language requirements, optionally restricting results by language, domain, Clean Architecture layer, and similarity score. It provides an AI function-tool facade for metadata lookup by Bindex identifier or URL, GraphQL-style response filtering, library selection, descriptor registration from JSON, files, and URLs, and retrieval of the Bindex schema and generation instructions. It is suited to AI-assisted application assembly, MCP server tool publishing, reusable-library governance, and Maven-based automation. MongoDB is the backing repository, while a configured GenAI and embedding provider supplies classification and vector embeddings.

constructors.description: Creates the AI-facing Bindex function-tool provider. The provider exposes operations for Bindex retrieval, recommendation, registration, schema retrieval, and generation-prompt retrieval; its MongoDB repository is initialized lazily from the supplied runtime configurator during tool invocation.

examples.description: Create the function-tool provider after adding Bindex Core to the host application or MCP server classpath. The host tool runtime discovers its annotated operations and supplies the configurator when a tool is invoked.

constructors.description: Creates a MongoDB-backed Bindex repository using connection details from the configurator, including BINDEX_REPO_URL and optional credentials. Close the repository after use so a client created by the repository is released.

examples.description: Create the repository with a configured org.machanism.macha.core.commons.configurator.Configurator, retrieve a descriptor by its Bindex ID, and use try-with-resources to close the MongoDB client.

constructors.description: Creates the semantic Bindex workflow coordinator. Picker uses the configured GenAI and embedding providers with a BindexRepository to save descriptors with embeddings and recommend artifacts for natural-language requests.

examples.snippet:
org.machanism.machai.bindex.core.Picker picker = new org.machanism.machai.bindex.core.Picker(repository, configurator);
java.util.Collection<org.machanism.machai.bindex.core.BindexInfo> matches = picker.pick(requirements, 25L, 0.85D, configurator);
examples.description: Construct a picker with a repository and configured AI providers, then request up to 25 relevant Bindex records that meet a similarity threshold of 0.85.

features.name: pick
features.signature: public java.util.Collection<org.machanism.machai.bindex.core.BindexInfo> pick(java.lang.String prompt, long vectorSearchLimits, double score, org.machanism.macha.core.commons.configurator.Configurator configurator) throws java.io.IOException
features.description: Classifies a natural-language requirement, generates an embedding through the configured provider, and queries the repository for relevant Bindex records subject to result-limit and minimum-score settings.

examples.description: Use a practical requirements sentence in the requirements variable to identify libraries for an application feature, then inspect the returned identifiers, versions, descriptions, and relevance scores.

features.name: getBindex
features.signature: public org.machanism.machai.schema.Bindex getBindex(java.lang.String id, java.lang.String query, java.io.File projectDir, org.machanism.macha.core.commons.configurator.Configurator configurator) throws java.io.IOException
features.description: Retrieves a Bindex descriptor by Bindex coordinates or a remote descriptor URL. A GraphQL-style selection query can reduce the returned payload to fields needed by an AI workflow.

examples.snippet: org.machanism.machai.schema.Bindex descriptor = tools.getBindex(bindexId, graphqlSelection, projectDirectory, configurator);
examples.description: Look up a known descriptor and optionally set graphqlSelection to a GraphQL-style selection such as { name version classification { languages } } to return only planning-relevant fields.

features.name: registerBindex
features.signature: public java.lang.String registerBindex(java.lang.String path, java.io.File projectDir, org.machanism.macha.core.commons.configurator.Configurator configurator) throws java.io.IOException
features.description: Reads and registers a schema-compliant Bindex descriptor from a project-relative file path or supported remote location, making it available to repository-backed semantic discovery.

examples.description: After generating and reviewing bindex.json, set bindexFilePath to its project-relative path, register it, and retain the returned record ID for operational tracking.

features.name: filterJson
features.signature: static com.fasterxml.jackson.databind.JsonNode filterJson(java.lang.Object data, java.lang.String graphqlQuery)
features.description: Internally applies a GraphQL-style selection set to JSON-compatible Bindex data, allowing tool responses to be narrowed before they are returned to token-sensitive AI clients.

examples.description: Use the filter when an integration needs only a limited metadata projection, such as identity and classification, rather than a complete descriptor.

customizations.name: BINDEX_REPO_URL
customizations.description: Configures the MongoDB connection URI used by MongoBindexRepository. When absent, the repository uses its configured default connection behavior.

examples.description: Set this environment variable before running an MCP server or host application to direct Bindex storage and vector search to a local MongoDB instance.

customizations.name: picker.classificationInstruction
customizations.description: Overrides the prompt template that Picker uses to classify natural-language requirements before embedding and semantic search.

studs.name: org.machanism.machai.bindex.core.BindexRepository
studs.description: Gateway contract for storing, retrieving, and semantically finding Bindex descriptors. Implement this interface to provide an alternative repository adapter.

examples.description: Program to the BindexRepository interface so the picker and application workflows can use the provided MongoDB adapter or a compatible custom adapter.

examples.title: Install and publish Bindex tools through an MCP server
steps: Add org.machanism.machai:bindex-core:1.3.0 as a dependency of the Machai MCP Server Maven plugin, or download the Bindex Core JAR and place it beside the Machai MCP Server JAR.
Configure GENAI_USERNAME, GENAI_PASSWORD, gw.model, embedding.model, BINDEX_REPO_URL, BINDEX_USER, and BINDEX_PASSWORD for the target environment.
Start org.machanism.machai.mcp.server.McpServer with Bindex Core on the classpath and a chosen port.
Connect an MCP client and invoke get_bindex, pick_libraries, or register_bindex for a real library-discovery workflow.
examples.scenario: An IDE assistant asks for Java components for an AI-assisted application. The MCP client invokes pick_libraries, retrieves details through get_bindex, and registers any reviewed in-house component through register_bindex.

examples.title: Create and register a Bindex descriptor in a Maven project
steps: Generate Javadoc and the effective POM for the Maven library.
Create a schema-compliant bindex.json that includes Maven coordinates, detailed classification, constructors, features, and practical examples.
Validate the descriptor against the Bindex v2 schema.
Configure MongoDB and GenAI credentials, then register the project-relative bindex.json through the Bindex registration tool.
examples.scenario: A library team publishes a new reusable Java component. Registering its reviewed descriptor makes it searchable for future application-assembly and dependency-selection requests.
